title: fix(plugin-detail): format the summary chip's currency and dates in the display locale
body:
Fixes #9453

`useDisplayLocale`'s own doc comment names the one thing a caller must not do: reach past the hook and hand `Intl` the literal `undefined`, which means the MACHINE's locale — neither the tenant channel nor the UI-language one. The `summaryFields` chip beside the record H1 did exactly that in four places. All four now read `displayLocale`, the binding this same render already holds for the percent branch (objectui#9167), so every family in the chip's format switch is on one channel.

## The diff, in full

Four argument tokens in `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx` — the currency branch, its unresolved-currency number fallback, and both date branches — each `undefined` becoming `displayLocale`. Nothing else in those four option bags moved. Plus one comment block above the switch, one pin, one changeset. `git diff` adds exactly 4 non-comment lines to the component.

## ⛔ Only the locale moved, and the `en` rows are what enforces that

objectui#9453 carries an open question it deliberately did not answer: whether a KPI chip beside a title should keep its deliberately compact face (`maximumFractionDigits: 0`, `dateStyle: 'medium'`, `timeStyle: 'short'`) or read exactly like its list cell. That question is out of scope here, so `EN_CONTROL_ROWS` in the new pin states the `en` readings as literals. Those four rows are green on the pre-change tree AND after it — a repair that also rounded differently, or swapped the date style, is red there even though every `de-DE` row would still pass.

## The pin, and why it is not a measurement of the runner

`packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/summaryChip.displayLocale-9453.test.tsx`, 12 cases. Both legs DECLARE the session locale: the mount through `LocalizationProvider`, the expectation as a literal. That is the same mount objectui#9167 pinned the percent half of this switch through.

The literal table alone would still be a machine-dependent pin — red before this change only because this runner resolves to `en-US`. So the case that carries the card is `is a reading of the session locale, not of the machine`: for each family it renders the SAME stored value under `en` and under `de-DE` and requires the two readings to differ. Before this change both readings came from the machine, whatever it was, so they were byte-identical — that case is red on EVERY runner, a German one included.

The currency amounts are written as EUR in this prose on purpose, following the card: GitHub rewrites body bytes, and a table meant to show a symbol difference is worth nothing if the symbol is what moves. The test asserts the real bytes.

## Evidence

Ablation, run from the committed fix, with an on-disk proof on both legs (blob hashes, not exit codes) and a trap-based restore:

| leg | tree | result |
|---|---|---|
| mutated | `DetailView.tsx` restored from `f0b497921` (4 `displayLocale` call sites became 4 `undefined`, verified by grep count and by a changed blob hash) | `8 failed \| 4 passed (12)` — the 4 passing are exactly `EN_CONTROL_ROWS` |
| restored | `git checkout HEAD -- FILE`, on-disk blob re-equals the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty | `12 passed (12)` |

Commands, all at repo root, on merged head `6bf2a299d`:

| command | reading |
|---|---|
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/` (through the shared lock) | `Test Files 183 passed (183)` · `Tests 1756 passed (1756)` · `VERDICT command-exit 0` |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check` | exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, so the pin is type-checked too) |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail lint` | exit 0 |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | green, 1 changeset declared |
| `check:control-bytes` · `check:new-line-citations` · `check:test-path-roots` · `check:changeset-claims` · `check:pending-changeset-literals` · `check:unreferenced-sources` · `check:i18n-keys` · `check:i18n-drift` · `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` | all exit 0 |

**Declared narrowing.** Repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the full `pnpm test` farm are CI's run, not this seat's. What was measured locally instead is the affected package's OWN full lint — `eslint .` inside `packages/plugin-detail`, which is what `turbo run lint` runs for it: **240 files** (count read from `--format json`, not estimated), **0 errors**, 1023 warnings, all pre-existing and un-gated (`.github/workflows/lint.yml` sets no `--max-warnings`). The narrowing is sound for untouched files because this repo's `eslint.config.js` configures **no** type-aware linting — no `parserOptions.project`, no `projectService`, no `tsconfigRootDir` anywhere in it — so nothing in this diff can move the verdict on a file it does not contain.

**Clause-②: `no`, re-measured at delivery.** `^\+export` over the whole diff = **0**. No exported symbol moves, no type is added or changed, no key is added to a published payload; the four changed tokens are argument expressions inside a component body. Measured against the built artefacts rather than argued: `packages/plugin-detail/dist/*.d.ts` contains no `displayLocale`, and `dist/` carries nothing from the new test file — with a lit positive control, since the same grep DOES find `data-summary-chip` in `dist/index.js`, so the instrument was working. The package publishes `files: ["dist", …]` only.

## Serial

`main` was merged into this branch before this PR opened (`c1006ed8e`), per the dispatch. Open PR objectui#8941 also touches this file, at a `lucide-react` icon name roughly two hundred lines above this surface; no hand-ordering was attempted and the merge queue arbitrates. If objectui#8941 lands while this is in flight, `main` gets merged again.

## Acceptance notes

Noted while in this file, deliberately NOT filed and NOT fixed here — the dispatch scopes this card to these four call sites:

- `packages/plugin-detail` has further `Intl` call sites on the machine locale outside this card's surface: `RecordMetaFooter.tsx` builds an `Intl.DateTimeFormat` with a literal `undefined`, and `ActivityTimeline.tsx`, `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`, `RecordComments.tsx`, `ThreadedReplies.tsx`, `HistoryTimeline.tsx`, `PointInTimeRestore.tsx`, `ConcurrentUpdateDialog.tsx` and `DiffView.tsx` each call `toLocaleDateString()` / `toLocaleString()` with no locale argument at all. Same contract sentence, different surfaces; carrier for a future card: whoever next moves this package's date rendering.
- objectui#9453's body heads its evidence section "three call sites in one switch" and then lists four, which is also the number this branch changed. A body inconsistency only; the table underneath it is correct.
